name: Backup Zip On Load
description: At load time, Aurora tooling (editor and MCP server) MUST begin creating a timestamped backup ZIP of the entire model home under `aurora/backups/` (for example `MIS-001-20260210T061800Z.zip`). Backup creation MUST be asynchronous and MUST NOT block UI interactivity or tool-call responsiveness. If backup creation fails, the tool MUST warn the user but continue loading. A configurable number of ZIPs will be retained (default 5), with older backups automatically deleted.
